depth: The depth map captures the downward-tilted egocentric layout of a room where the seated camera wearer's knees, hands, and held notebook in the lower background are brightest at 3 to 5 metres and out of arm's reach, resting above a low green-cloth stool about 3 to 5 metres away. segmentation: The segmentation map outlines discrete background and foreground regions across the five frames, separating the camera wearer's hands and legs at 3 to 5 metres in the bottom background and out of reach from the open book they hold (3 to 5 metres, out of arm's reach) and the upper-left wall/doorway structure 0.5 to 1.2 metres away and within reach. It also fails to generate any yellow body skeleton for either the camera wearer's visible legs in the bottom background or the second person moving away from 0.5 metres to 3 to 5 metres in the upper left of frames 3 to 5, whose head and gaze direction remain out of view above the frame.
